property_summary: For any caller and any single call to play() sending exactly TICKET_AMOUNT, the reference contract always resets pot to 0 whenever the computed random equals 0 (so pot after play() is either 0 or increased by TICKET_AMOUNT depending on randomness); the mutant flips the branch to reset when random == 1, so there exist inputs (i.e., randomness outcomes) where the mutant's pot differs from the reference's pot — the test fuzzes the caller and relies on the randomness outcome to expose the divergence by observing pot after play().
change_summary: Change the random branch condition to trigger on random == 1 instead of 0, altering when pot is reset and thus observable pot value.
